# spatial measurement of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:spatialMeasurementOf`](gmeow-spatialMeasurementOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/spatialMeasurementOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The entity whose spatial property is being measured — the [`observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) of a spatial measurement. Subproperty of [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) so generic consumers can query all observations without knowing the domain.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:SpatialMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialMeasurement.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:spatialMeasurementOf`](gmeow-spatialMeasurementOf.md) from [`gmeow:SpatialMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialMeasurement.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md), [`gmeow:SpatialMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialMeasurement.md), [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the entity whose spatial property a measurement observes; a subproperty of [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid bypassing the [`observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) spine — assert this so generic consumers can query all observations uniformly.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:spatialMeasurementOf`](gmeow-spatialMeasurementOf.md) on the [`SpatialMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialMeasurement.md); [`gmeow:coordinateObservationOf`](gmeow-coordinateObservationOf.md) specializes it for places.

### Examples

- ex:m [`gmeow:spatialMeasurementOf`](gmeow-spatialMeasurementOf.md) ex:edinburgh.
